cells: Requires `--experimental-without-rowid`. Effectively **insert-only**: CREATE / INSERT / SELECT work (incl. composite PK), but UPDATE, DELETE, UPSERT, `INSERT OR REPLACE`, secondary UNIQUE constraints, secondary `CREATE INDEX`, `FOREIGN KEY`, CDC, and materialized views are all rejected. AUTOINCREMENT and missing PK rejection are parity with SQLite.

AUTOINCREMENT and missing PK rejection are parity with SQLite. |
